scientific_integrity: Exact analytic derivation and global sign proof, independently replayable polynomial identities in check.py. Numerical examples not used to certify universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to one deterministic point observation of once-integrated standard Brownian motion on [0,1], with independent known Gaussian noise and integrated posterior path variance. Earlier specialized optimal-design literature may contain equivalent statements; independent validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp endpoint-activation threshold for one noisy integrated-Wiener sensor
